facts.subject: main/melee/ft/ftaction:ftAction_80072320
facts.value: Direction selector values 0–3 choose neutral, positive, negative, or facing-dependent direction. Destination selectors 0, 1, 3, 4, and 5 always start and register the sound in their respective Fighter slots. Selectors 2 and 6 normally write `x2144` and `x2148`, but when `x2225_b6` is set they suppress playback for every Fighter kind except Mr. Game & Watch and Samus. Selector 0 uses channel value 0 and terminal parameter -1; selectors 1–6 derive a per-player value from `player_id + x221F_b4` and add selector-specific offsets.
